title: Theoretical Investigation by DFT and Molecular Docking of Synthesized Oxidovanadium(IV)-Based Imidazole Drug Complexes as Promising Anticancer Agents.
authors: Basaleh, Amal S; Alomari, Fatimah Y; Sharfalddin, Abeer A; Al-Radadi, Najlaa S; Domyati, Doaa; Hussien, Mostafa A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氧化钒咪唑配合物的合成、DFT计算及与DNA的非共价结合和分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以DFT和对接为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Vanadium compounds have been set in various fields as anticancer, anti-diabetic, anti-parasitic, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial agents. This study reports the synthesis and structural characterization of oxidovanadium(IV)-based imidazole drug complexes by the elemental analyzer, molar conductance, magnetic moment, spectroscopic techniques, as well as thermal analysis. The obtained geometries were studied theoretically using density functional theory (DFT) under the B3LYP level. The DNA-binding nature of the ligands and their synthesized complexes has been studied by the electronic absorption titrations method. The biological studies were carried with in-vivo assays and the molecular docking method. The EPR spectra asserted the geometry around the vanadium center to be a square pyramid for metal complexes. The geometries have been confirmed using DFT under the B3LYP level. Moreover, the quantum parameters proposed promising bioactivity of the oxidovanadium(IV) complexes. The results of the DNA-binding revealed that the investigated complexes bind to DNA via non-covalent mode, and the intrinsic binding constant (K(b)) value for the [VO(SO(4))(MNZ)(2)] H(2)O complex was promising, which was 2.0 x 10(6) M(-1). Additionally, the cytotoxic activity of the synthesized complexes exhibited good inhibition toward both hepatocellular carcinoma (HepG-2) and human breast cancer (HCF-7) cell lines. The results of molecular docking displayed good correlations with experimental cytotoxicity findings. Therefore, these findings suggest that our synthesized complexes can be introduced as effective anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 钒化合物已在多个领域被用作抗癌、抗糖尿病、抗寄生虫、抗病毒和抗菌剂。本研究通过元素分析仪、摩尔电导率、磁矩、光谱技术以及热分析，报道了基于氧化钒(IV)的咪唑药物复合物的合成与结构表征。所得几何结构在B3LYP水平下使用密度泛函理论 (density functional theory, DFT) 进行了理论研究。配体及其合成复合物的DNA结合性质已通过电子吸收滴定法研究。生物学研究通过体内实验和分子对接方法进行。EPR光谱证实了金属复合物中钒中心周围的几何结构为四方锥形。几何结构已在B3LYP水平下使用DFT确认。此外，量子参数提出了氧化钒(IV)复合物具有前景的生物活性。DNA结合结果表明，所研究的复合物通过非共价模式与DNA结合，且[VO(SO(4))(MNZ)(2)] H(2)O复合物的内在结合常数 (K(b)) 值具有前景，为2.0 x 10(6) M(-1)。此外，合成复合物的细胞毒性活性对肝细胞癌 (HepG-2) 和人乳腺癌 (HCF-7) 细胞系均表现出良好的抑制作用。分子对接结果与实验细胞毒性发现显示出良好的相关性。因此，这些发现表明我们合成的复合物可作为有效的抗癌剂引入。
